features.name: class_function_method_definition
features.evidence: AST ClassDef, FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef; lexical IDs and defines edges

features.name: source_locations
features.evidence: 1-based AST source line intervals; optional columns are not output

features.name: import_syntax
features.evidence: Import and ImportFrom produce source-backed unresolved imports hints

features.name: nested_definitions
features.evidence: Nested functions are recorded under lexical defines parent; calls remain conservative

features.name: async_definitions
features.evidence: AsyncFunctionDef emits function/method definitions without await semantics

features.name: decorator_expressions
features.evidence: Decorator expressions are deliberately not traversed

features.name: signature_expression_calls
features.evidence: Default values and annotations are not traversed for expression calls

features.name: local_lexical_calls
features.evidence: Resolve only unique undecorated and unshadowed module-level functions

features.name: cross_module_call_targets
features.evidence: Cross-module declaration candidates are separate non-CCG companion evidence

features.name: dynamic_runtime_dispatch
features.evidence: No imports or execution of analyzed modules; attributes are not resolved

features.name: parser_failures
features.evidence: SyntaxError recorded in unprocessed coverage and explicit diagnostic

features.name: relative_import_alias_syntax
features.evidence: ImportFrom hints retain relative dots and imported name, not runtime identity

features.name: conditional_and_star_import_resolution
features.evidence: Source import syntax observed but runtime identity and conditional binding not resolved

limitations: Complete coverage means all supplied Python paths parsed; semantic completeness not implied.
Caller is responsible for obtaining and pinning the complete intended repository snapshot.
No built-in glob includes/excludes: absent paths are not enumerated or assessed.
Imports and dynamic calls retain unresolved hints rather than fabricated targets.
Method dispatch, decorators, function signature calls and lambda bodies are not comprehensively modeled.
